## Problem and solution

Describe the problem, the focused solution, and any intentional non-goals.

## Verification

List the commands run and attach relevant evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated refactor.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes, or the reason they do not is explained.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are included.
- [ ] UI changes include relevant Playwright coverage and screenshots.
